predecessors.name: East Francia
predecessors.text: the East Frankish kingdom of the Carolingians; in 911 the nobles of Saxony, Franconia, Bavaria and Swabia 'no longer followed the tradition' of choosing a Carolingian and chose Conrad I

successors.name: Holy Roman Empire
successors.text: the whole realm of Otto I, German lands and, from late 961, Italy, passes into the Empire on his coronation at Rome

ledger.x: 911: the nobles of Saxony, Franconia, Bavaria and Swabia elect Conrad I king of the East Franks.
919: the crown passes from the Franconian Conrad I to the Saxon Henry the Fowler, founder of the Ottonian line.
921: Henry marches against Duke Arnulf of Bavaria, who had taken the royal title.
921: Arnulf of Bavaria renounces the crown and submits to Henry.
923: Henry the Fowler invades Lotharingia, then held for West Francia.
925: the fighting for Lotharingia ends in Henry's favour.
925: Lotharingia passes to the German king.
926: the Basel estates go to Burgundy for the Holy Lance.
928: Henry takes Brandenburg from the Hevelli.
928-929: Henry conquers the Slav stronghold of Gana (Jahna) in the winter campaign.
929: Duke Wenceslaus of Bohemia is forced to pay tribute again.
934: Henry conquers Schleswig from the Danes.
936: the Danes hold Schleswig again in Cliopatria.
936: Boleslaus of Bohemia breaks with the Saxons.
936: the Bohemian war begins.
936-937: Otto sets up the Billung and Gero marches on the Slav frontier.
939: Otto invades Lotharingia against the rebel Duke Gilbert, who had tried on Henry's death to swap Lotharingia to the West Franks.
939: the revolt of the dukes ends at Andernach.
947: the Obotrites, whose Cliopatria row ends in 946, appear under the German king in Cliopatria's shape.
947: Cliopatria's shape grows over the rest of the Elbe-Oder country, Gero's march; no opened page dates it.
950: the Bohemian war ends.
950: Boleslaus I of Bohemia makes peace and resumes paying tribute to Otto.
951: Otto enters Pavia and takes the Lombard crown.
952: Otto gives Italy back to Berengar as a fief.
952: Berengar II becomes Otto's vassal for the kingdom of Italy.
952: Friuli passes to Otto's brother Henry of Bavaria as the March of Verona.
955: the Obotrites invade Saxony.
955: Otto wins at the Recknitz.
960: Cliopatria's shape grows over Austria, Slovenia and Carinthia, taken from its Principality of Hungary of 955.
961: Otto takes Italy into his own hand.
961: Otto I becomes King of Italy at Pavia at Christmas, and Cliopatria draws Italy as German for the year.
962: Otto I is crowned Emperor at Rome and the German kingdom becomes the core of the Holy Roman Empire.

wars.name: Henry the Fowler's war with Arnulf of Bavaria
wars.outcome: Henry defeated Arnulf in two campaigns in 921 and Arnulf renounced the crown and submitted.

wars.name: Henry the Fowler's conquest of Lotharingia
wars.outcome: Henry invaded in 923 and the Lotharingians elected him king in 925; Lotharingia became the Duchy of Lorraine within the German kingdom.

wars.name: Henry the Fowler's Slav campaigns
wars.outcome: Henry took Brandenburg (winter 928) and Gana (Jahna) and forced Wenceslaus of Bohemia back to tribute in 929; the Redarii were routed at Lenzen on 4 September 929.

wars.name: Hungarian invasions under Henry the Fowler
wars.outcome: A ten-year truce in 924, then victory at the Battle of Riade in 933, which 'ended Magyar attacks for the next 21 years'.

wars.name: Otto I's Bohemian war
wars.outcome: Boleslaus I of Bohemia attacked an ally of the Saxons in 936; the war 'was not concluded until 950, when Otto besieged a castle owned by Boleslaus' son', and Boleslaus agreed to peace and to resume paying tribute.

wars.name: Revolt of the dukes (Eberhard and Gilbert)
wars.outcome: Eberhard was killed and Gilbert drowned in the Rhine at Andernach in 939; Otto took Franconia into direct rule and Louis IV recognised his suzerainty over Lorraine.

wars.name: Otto I's Italian expedition of 951-952
wars.outcome: Otto entered Pavia on 23 September 951 and took the Lombard crown; Berengar II did homage at Augsburg in August 952, kept Italy as a fief and ceded Friuli, which became the March of Verona.

wars.name: Revolt of Liudolf and Conrad
wars.outcome: The rebellion ended at the Diet of Arnstadt in December 954; Henry was confirmed as Duke of Bavaria.

wars.name: Battle of Lechfeld and the Recknitz campaign
wars.outcome: Otto defeated the Hungarians at the Lechfeld on 10 August 955 and the Obotrites at the Recknitz on 16 October 955.

wars.name: Otto I's Italian expedition of 961-962
wars.outcome: Otto entered Italy in August 961, took the kingship at Pavia around Christmas and was crowned Emperor in Rome in early February 962; Berengar II surrendered at San Leo in 963.

certainty.note: No treaty or survey fixes any frontier; the pages opened give no treaty line (the 921 Treaty of Bonn with Charles the Simple is mentioned without one).
